training_provenance.checkpoint_type: official Laya decision checkpoint, fine-tuned from ModernBERT encoder

action_question.instructions: Choose exactly one action macro for this 60 FPS platformer. Apply these rules to the provided state in order: (1) if grounded=true and obstacle_ahead=true, gap_ahead=true, enemy_ahead=true, or stalled_frames>=3, choose right_run_jump; (2) if grounded=true and none of those conditions hold, choose right_run; (3) if grounded=false, choose right_run_jump when a gap or hazard is ahead, otherwise choose right_run. Distances are coarse player-left tile-column estimates, not exact front-edge distances. Use only the candidate names below.

criteria.noop: No input; brake when grounded, keep air momentum.
criteria.right: Walk right grounded; right air control.
criteria.right_run: Run right grounded; right air control.
criteria.right_jump: Normal right jump when grounded; right air control in air.
criteria.right_run_jump: Strong right jump when grounded; right air control in air.
criteria.jump: Vertical jump when grounded; no double jump.
